claim_text: Since 2019, Minnesota judges have ordered defendants in Medicaid Fraud Control Unit-prosecuted cases to pay nearly $32 million in criminal restitution; as of May 2026, only just over $3 million (roughly 9%) had actually been collected in the state court system, per a 5 INVESTIGATES review of state court records.
normalized_claim: MFCU criminal restitution: ~$32M ordered (2019-2026) vs ~$3M collected (as of May 2026), ~9% collection rate.

supporting_passages.quote: judges have ordered defendants to pay back nearly $32 million in restitution in MFCU-prosecuted cases... the amount recorded as paid back in the state court system was just over three million dollars

qualifiers: Scope is MFCU-prosecuted cases only, state-court restitution orders; does not include federal cases, civil judgments, or forfeiture.
The $32M figure is a component of, not identical to, the AG's headline $90M 'judgments and recoveries' figure.
